The FloPlast universal hopper provides an efficient rainwater drainage solution, designed to fit both 65mm square and 68mm round downpipes. This versatile uPVC hopper, finished in white, offers a flow capacity up to 1.14 litres per second. It is ideal for various building and plumbing projects, including new build installations and refurbishment work, and ensures broad compatibility with components from most major drainage system manufacturers.
